name: Short Cut Tuna, Potato, Cucumber & Mixed Green Salad with Honey Mustard Dressing

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the cucumber and mixed greens (skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed). Cut cucumber into bite-sized pieces, then place in a medium bowl along with the mixed greens.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ English cucumber
1 (142 g) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Drain potatoes in a colander. Add to the bowl along with dressing, salt, and pepper, then toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (425 g) can boiled potatoes, canned
¼ cup honey mustard dressing
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Top with tuna and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 2 (74 g) pouch seasoned tuna, herb & garlic flavor
